id.description: Stable provider id used in provider/model references.

base_url.description: Chat endpoint, or an OpenAI-compatible base ending in /v1. Must not end in a slash.

base_url_requires_override.description: True when this host is a placeholder rather than a usable endpoint (Azure's RESOURCE.openai.azure.com): every connection must supply its own base URL, and the gateway refuses to dispatch or save one that does not. Only a placeholder host (first label resource, your-resource or placeholder) may set it.

auth.description: bearer -> Authorization: Bearer <key>; x-api-key -> the key in x-api-key; api-key -> the key in `auth_header`; none -> no credential.

auth_header.description: Header that carries the key when `auth` is `api-key`. Defaults to `api-key`. `authorization`, `cookie` and hop-by-hop names are refused: use `bearer` for the Authorization header.

files_url.description: OpenAI-compatible file API root (POST /v1/files, list, retrieve, content). A full endpoint, no trailing slash and no query of its own; the gateway forwards uploads byte for byte with the client's multipart boundary.

batches_url.description: OpenAI-compatible batch API root (POST /v1/batches, list, retrieve, cancel). Forwarded, never executed by the gateway; no trailing slash and no query of its own.

rerank_url.description: Native rerank endpoint (Cohere and Jina both use POST /v1/rerank). A full endpoint, no trailing slash; the gateway posts the canonical rerank body to exactly this URL.

extra_headers.description: Headers every request to this provider carries. Credential-bearing and hop-by-hop names are refused, and no value may look like a token.

query.description: Query parameters every request to this provider carries, e.g. Azure's api-version. A parameter the connection's base URL already sets wins, so a deployment can override a reviewed default. Credential-bearing names are refused.

max_tokens_key.description: How the Chat dialect spells the output cap for this provider. `max_completion_tokens` only for OpenAI's own surface: current gpt-5/o-series models reject `max_tokens`, and Mistral-class APIs answer 422 to `max_completion_tokens`.

passthrough_headers.description: Client protocol beta headers this provider understands and the gateway may forward, unioned with its own. Only these two reviewed names exist, so a manifest cannot forward a credential header.

endpoints.description: Human review metadata; the compiled spec uses the *_url fields.
